title: Fuse complementary proposals
summary: Create a new synthesis from compatible, attributed elements.
useWhen: Different approaches contain useful complementary elements.
avoidWhen: Combining incompatible assumptions hides a decision.
contract: Fix the rubric before drafting and retain complete scorecards.
Track provenance and explain rejected elements.
Resolve unknowns and contradictions in main-session acceptance.
A fusion is a new artifact; prior candidate checks do not validate it.
example: Combine a simple public API with another proposal's failure-handling strategy, then test the combined design.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Proposal A] --> F[Attributed synthesis]
  B[Proposal B] --> F
  F --> C[Resolve contradictions]
  C --> V[Fresh acceptance]
